pool.text: Ali ibn Hammud conquered Tangier during realm civil wars.
Yusuf ibn Tashfin captured Tangier for the Almoravids.
Tangier fell to Abd al-Mumin's Almohads.
Abu Yusuf Yaqub compelled Tangier allegiance with siege.
The traveler Ibn Battuta was born in Tangier.
The Portuguese occupied Tangier unopposed after garrison fled.
Tangier was given to England King Charles II.
Slimane of Morocco gifted urban mansion to United States.
Tangier was bombarded by French under Prince Joinville.
Kaiser Wilhelm II triggered international crisis in Tangier.
Tangier became international zone managed by colonial powers.
Fondation Lorin opened in a former synagogue.
Spanish troops occupied Tangier during World War II.
Morocco reintegrated Tangier at signing of Tangier Protocol.
Tanger-Med port outside Tangier became functional.
King Mohammed VI restored city shipping and tourist facilities.
Tangier hosted the Connect route development forum.
